contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus register, emit and unregister operations require the events permission
contract.denied_register: A registration attempt without events permission raises PermissionError
contract.denied_register_integrity: A denied registration does not mutate the listener registry
contract.allowed_emit: An authorized plugin can emit events normally
contract.denied_emit: An emit attempt without events permission raises PermissionError
contract.denied_emit_delivery: A denied emit produces no callback delivery
contract.denied_unregister: An unregister attempt without events permission raises PermissionError
contract.denied_unregister_integrity: A denied unregister does not mutate the listener registry
contract.permission_recovery: Restoring events permission allows normal callback removal
contract.registry_cleanup: Authorized unregister restores the empty listener registry
contract.permission_check_visibility: Permission checks are observable through the permission provider
